column1: # What is inside a named group.
# A recipe never names a package. It names a group — "media players", "printing" — and this file
# says what that means. Two consequences, both deliberate:
#   A group is the unit of KEEPING as well as of removing. prune.also_keep: [printing] keeps the
#   whole printing stack, because keeping one file out of a printing stack gives you a printer that
#   Nothing on schema/PROTECTED.md's list appears in any group here, and test/prune.test.ts fails
#   if it ever does. That test is the point of this file being data rather than prose.
#   group     the name as a recipe writes it
#   ref       the Flatpak application id, or the rpm package name
